hotel_facts.label: Check in, check out
hotel_facts.text: Check in at 4 PM, check out at 11 AM.

hotel_facts.label: Breakfast and pool
hotel_facts.text: Breakfast is free, and there's an outdoor pool. The hours come from a third-party listing, so ask at the desk.

hotel_facts.label: Valet
hotel_facts.text: $47 a day, and spots are limited.

transit.label: On foot
transit.text: Bourbon Street and the Superdome are 20 to 30 minutes on foot, by our estimate. The French Quarter is better by rideshare after dark.

transit.label: Streetcar
transit.text: $1.25 a ride, or a Jazzy Pass for $3 a day. The St. Charles line runs downtown. The Canal line only goes as far as Canal and LaSalle. Drivers don't make change.

transit.label: Airport taxi
transit.text: A flat $36 to downtown for up to two people. Airport taxis take cards.

transit.label: To the shows
transit.text: Your bus pass covers the ride to the UNO Lakefront Arena and back, from the Maple Leaf Bar on Oak Street. Get to the Maple Leaf by 4 both days, about 16 to 25 minutes Uptown by rideshare (estimate).

transit.label: Clocks
transit.text: Clocks fall back at 2 AM Sunday. Sunday's sunset is 5:13 PM.

nearby.name: Walgreens, 900 Canal St
nearby.text: The nearest pharmacy we could confirm, about 0.8 miles.

safety.label: Getting home late
safety.text: Take Uber or Lyft after midnight rather than hailing a cab, and check the plate and the driver's name.

safety.label: Go cups
safety.text: In the French Quarter you can walk out of a bar with a drink in a plastic cup, never glass or a can.

safety.label: Last call
safety.text: New Orleans has no set closing time, so some bars run all night.

weather_note.text: Friday 79° and 67°, 5% chance of rain. Saturday 80° and 67°, 58% chance, with storms. Sunday 80° and 66°, 46% chance. Sunset 6:14 PM Friday and Saturday, 5:13 PM Sunday.

fri.title: Friday until the bus
fri.weather: Dry and about 79°, the nicest day of the three.

stops.name: Mother's Restaurant
stops.note: Breakfast all day, five blocks from the hotel. Get the debris and a biscuit.

stops.name: Ogden Museum
stops.note: Opens at 10. Southern art, right beside the hotel.

stops.name: Julia Street galleries
stops.note: A few blocks of galleries on the way toward Canal. Free to browse.

stops.name: Carousel Bar
stops.note: The Royal Caravan Brass Band plays at 12:30. A Vieux Carré on the turning bar.

stops.name: Napoleon House
stops.note: A Pimm's Cup and a muffuletta.

stops.name: St. Louis Cathedral
stops.address: 615 Pere Antoine Alley, New Orleans, LA 70116
stops.note: Through Jackson Square to the cathedral, open until 5. The square's artists are out when the weather's good.

stops.name: Café Du Monde
stops.note: Beignets and café au lait before the ride Uptown.

stops.name: Maple Leaf Bar
stops.note: Leave the Quarter by about 3:15. Polytoxic plays the pregame, then the bus to the arena.
stops.leg: A rideshare Uptown, about 6 miles. Check the app for the time

sat.title: Saturday until the bus
sat.weather: Storms likely, heaviest around 3 to 6. This one stays mostly indoors. Bring the umbrella.

stops.name: Willa Jean
stops.note: Southern breakfast and pastries, open from 7. There's a waitlist on busy mornings.

stops.name: National WWII Museum
stops.note: Opens at 9 and takes as long as you give it. A good place to wait out rain.

stops.name: The Sazerac House
stops.note: The cocktail's own museum, opens at 11, at the foot of Canal.

stops.name: Erin Rose
stops.note: Killer Po' Boys in the back room. The pork belly po' boy with lime slaw.

stops.name: Preservation Hall
stops.note: Wendell Brunious and the Preservation Hall Legacy Band at 2:30. Reserve a seat on the Hall's calendar; Saturday's early sets still had seats. Leave by about 3:15 for the Maple Leaf.

stops.name: Maple Leaf Bar
stops.note: Johnny Sketch & the Dirty Notes play the pregame, 4 to 7, then the bus to the arena.
stops.leg: A rideshare Uptown, about 5 miles. Check the app for the time

bus.ride: About 5 miles Uptown from the hotel, roughly 16 to 25 minutes by rideshare (estimate)
bus.includes: The pregame show, the bus to the UNO Lakefront Arena and back (drinks on the bus), and the Bloodkin afterparty at the Maple Leaf after the show. Panic tickets aren't part of it.
bus.note: The bus's leaving time isn't posted. The pass covers 4 to 8 PM, so the pregame is the safe bet.

body: Hey Baby, two nights of Panic in New Orleans on Halloween weekend. Tap the star on anything you like and it'll wait for you up top.
Saturday looks stormy, so bring the umbrella to the Lakefront.
